title.zh-TW: Windows 執行背景與沙盒指令不再跳出黑視窗閃爍
title.en: Background and Sandboxed Commands on Windows No Longer Flash Black Windows

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上使用 Codex 處理專案時，工作節奏不再會被突如其來的畫面閃爍打斷。以前每當它在幕後啟動背景行程（在後台運作而不佔用畫面的程式）時，螢幕常會瞬間閃現黑框。執行沙盒指令（被限制在安全隔離環境中執行的指令）時也會出現同樣的彈窗干擾。現在 Codex 啟動這些背景任務時，跳出主控台（console，顯示純文字指令的介面）視窗的閃爍問題已經被修好。⟦像舞台助理在布幕後方安靜搬運道具，不會每次走動就突然拉開簾子干擾台前的表演。⟧
body.en: When working on projects with Codex on Windows, your workflow is no longer interrupted by sudden screen flashing. Previously, whenever it spawned background processes behind the scenes, black command prompt windows would often flash across the screen. Running sandboxed commands caused the same popup disruptions. Now, the flashing issue caused by popup console windows when Codex launches these background tasks has been fixed. ⟦Picture a stage assistant moving props quietly behind the curtains without pulling them open to disrupt the performance on stage every time they move around.⟧

items.original: Suppressed console windows flashing on Windows when Codex launches background processes and sandboxed commands. (#49385)
